composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-120a "MAST/EXTERIOR LIGHTS & SWITCHES") serves several distinct lighting/exterior-equipment circuits, all fed from the FWD DC DISTRIBUTION PANEL breakers Q11-Q14/QE1 through relays Re7-Re19 into terminal strip T/S F, and out to the MAST LIGHTS terminal blocks A-D. Titled sub-systems on the sheet: Mast Lights (Section A: anchor/windex/mast-up/steaming lts), Boom Lights + related deck/spreader/cockpit lamps (Section B), Tri-colour/DC mast socket group (Section C), pushbutton-controlled spreader/deck lamps (Section D — routed to PORT LAZ. J/BOX 2), Emergency Lights supply (QE1), FWD DC Sockets / Anchor Bay DC Sockets (Q13), Fog Horn + Aux Fog Horn with timer logic (Q14, T1/T2/Re18/Re19), LED Dimmer 1/2 outputs, and a small Hydraulics Emergency Stop status-lamp block tied to MYT/ONYX DIO/DO channels. Register mappings: MAST LTS -> 690-lts-mast, BOOM LTS -> 690-lts-boom, DECK LTS -> 690-lts-deck (fwd deck lt / cockpit boom lts treated under boom/deck groupings per label), NAV LIGHTS/STEAMING/spreader-red-green tri-colour set -> 690-navigation-lights (per engineer mapping for STEAMING LT./NAV LT. family), EMERGENCY LTS -> 693-emergency-lighting, DC SOCKETS/ANCHOR BAY DC SOCKETS -> 692-dc-sockets, FOG HORN -> 733-fog-horn, HYDRAULICS (emergency-stop status lamp) -> 570-myt-systems-hydraulics, ONYX-style DIO/DO tags -> 652-onyx-monitoring cross-reference. Bus/terminal/relay infrastructure (T/S E, T/S F, relay bank Re7-Re19) belongs to 640-dc-distribution as the FWD DC Distribution Panel's own bus structure feeding these circuits, not to any single load.

Register maps 'MAST LTS' to 690-lts-mast.

infrastructure.system_name: FWD DC Distribution Panel (T/S E, T/S F terminal strip, relay bank Re7-Re19)
facts: T/S E terminal 5 feeds QE1 (Emergency Lts Supply, 10A as printed) which taps into T/S F terminal 25.
T/S F is the sheet's large sequential terminal strip (terminals 25 through 91), many marked 'not used' — spare ways for future circuits.
Breakers Q11 (Mast Lights 10A), Q12 (Boom Lights 6A), Q13 (FWD DC Sockets 16A), Q14 (Fog Horn 16A) all originate here and route through relay bank Re7-Re19 into T/S F.

Relay bank Re7-Re19 acts as the switching/logic layer between breaker supply and the individual mast-light/boom-light/fog-horn loads; several relay coils (Re12, Re13, Re14, Re15) have diodes in series in their contact/coil-return paths — a recurring protective/isolation pattern on this panel.
Multi-core cables MU5-12, MU6-12, MU5a-12 exit this terminal strip toward AFT DC PANEL (MU5-12, MU5a-12) and LAZ. J/BOX 2 (MU6-12) — cross-sheet continuations, not detailed here.
T/S F terminal 22 has a cross-reference note 'MU4-12 [10] (see DWG120/112/111a)'.
Many T/S F terminals (25, 26, 31, 34, 43, 46, 50, 52, 58, 60, 64) are FUSED TERMINALS (built-in replaceable fuse) — troubleshooting culprits per sheet convention.

infrastructure.system_name: Fog Horn timer/relay logic module (T1, T2, Re9, Re18, Re19)
facts: T1 (30s-F) and T2 (5s-D) timers and relays Re9/Re18/Re19 form a local control-logic sub-assembly on the FWD DC panel dedicated to sequencing the fog horn sounding pattern; physically part of the panel's relay bank, feeding the 733-fog-horn equipment function (see equipment group above).
